SCOUT A CITY BEFORE YOU ARRIVE

The world, with a little perspective.

Fly to a destination, pick a place to land, and explore an AI-generated 360° scene with your crow at its center. Talk to the GPT-Live guide and turn your discoveries into a travel plan.

The 3D city and place details come from Google Maps. The crow flies a visual route; building collision avoidance is not simulated. Map imagery can be dated and generated scenes are imaginative impressions.

Instagram photos use recent public hashtags through a connected Meta account. They are not verified photos of the exact landing spot. AI plans include available web sources; check bookings and opening times before traveling.
